instrument: Walla Walla County Community Development publication practice
summary: The county publishes a dedicated page for the proposed facility hosting pre-application meeting recordings, the application, site plan and survey, with a note that one recording is posted in its entirety without editing.

source.citation: Walla Walla County Community Development, Amazon data center FAQ page

notes: Publication of unedited pre-application meeting recordings is a transparency practice not identified in any other jurisdiction in this corpus. Pre-application meetings are ordinarily the least visible stage of land use review, occurring before any public notice attaches. Directly relevant to the Oregon committee's question about what a centralized public reporting system would contain.
